title: Fourier degree of a path indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let a path on the $n$-dimensional binary cube fix some coordinates. The Fourier degree of the indicator of the set of inputs matching those fixed coordinates is at most the number of coordinates fixed by the path.
hypotheses_covered: A path on the $n$-dimensional binary cube
